# In-situ quantum handover: concrete operation, residual-state class, and the native basin gate

2 November 2026. Independent positive-constructor pass. The initial candidate—grow and protect the target collectively in place, instead of moving one growing FT block per final carrier—was recorded to the parent before reading its access approaches. The source code/thermal results below are used within their existing internally reviewed scope, not independently re-certified here.

## Result first

**A real constant-density quantum handover is available at the CSS-code layer:** interleave two identical macroscopic code blocks, perform transversal CNOT, measure the old block in X, and decode/track the logical phase. A sampled nonzero target syndrome is accommodated by a known classical frame shift. This transfers an arbitrary unknown logical qubit, including its external entanglement; it is not classical readout or known-state preparation. Only O(n) physical registers are needed, not n separate polylog-sized blocks. Its fault exposure must be analyzed as a whole active extended rectangle, including target preparation and waiting.

**This is not yet a native noisy WRITE theorem.** The attainable output has a finite-density residual error distribution, not the exact actual joint Gibbs gauge state. Moreover the previously reviewed filtered-parent preparation starts from H0+onsite bath+weak V; it has not been extended to the strongly noncommuting native clock reference. Those are two separate missing joins. At V=0 the native prefix-gauged reference commutes with the decoded logical algebra for every gauge state, so a globally trace-close Gibbs target is unnecessarily strong there. For nonzero allowed V, a local nonstationary-basin theorem for the explicit output class below is the right operational gate.

No permission denial, unavailable file, or access block occurred. The unmet gate is mathematical/physical, not operational tooling.

## 1. Resources and input, without a routing fiction

Use the actual bounded-density 3D CSS code C_n with one logical qubit and its fixed decoder D(s). Let V_s=D(s)V_0 be the syndrome-s logical embedding; Pauli phases are irrelevant. Use constant-many interleaved copies of each local physical site for source A, target B, and bounded-degree check ancillas. A constant rescaling of the 3D embedding admits them at constant density and bound

2 November 2026. These are boundary results, not a completed generic noisy loader.

## A. Exact dressed-bath basin: positive but rejected as the target solution

Let the native memory H0 have bounded-local commuting syndrome projectors Q_a and decoded logical algebra L, with [H0,Q_a]=[H0,L]=0. Here these are the prefix-dressed checks/logical operators, not bare checks. Add one finite-dimensional bath cell at each native site and a bath-only Hamiltonian and dissipator, at arbitrary fixed positive rates. The bath initial state need not be pure or thermal.

Choose W=product_i W_i, with each W_i onsite on the native carrier plus its bath cell and ||W_i-I||<=theta. Set the ACTUAL generator to

  L_actual = Ad_W o L_0 o Ad_(W†),

where L_0 consists of H0 plus the bath-only dynamics. Thus all actual jump operators are W_i(I tensor l_i)W_i†. They are genuine fixed-rate local noise contacts and may disturb physical data observables. The actual Hamiltonian is W(H0+H_B)W†. It remains two-site on constant-dimensional composite sites; its difference from H0+H_B has local norm O(theta) times the fixed local energy budget. This is a restricted isospectral perturbation family, NOT an arbitrary small V.

A direct sparse-syndrome lemma: suppose rho obeys Tr[rho product_(a in T) Q_a]<=q^|T|. If each check touches at most k composite sites and the check-support overlap graph has degree at most kappa-1, every T contains R of size >=|T|/kappa with disjoint check supports. For each selected a,

  W† Q_a W <= 2 Q_a + 2 k^2 theta^2 I.

This is (A+B)†(A+B)<=2A†A+2B†B applied to Q_a W_local. The selected inequalities have disjoint support and can be multiplied. Therefore every full or partial onsite product W obeys the syndrome-inclusion bound

  q -> f(q) = [2(q+k^2 theta^2)]^(1/kappa).

This holds for arbitrary bath correlations and quantum syndrome coherences. It has no system-size factor. Choose fixed q and theta small enough that f(f(q)) is within the banked decoder threshold.

The conjugated evolution is W exp(t L_0) W†. L_0 preserves every syndrome probability and every decoded logical observable. Telescope W and W† into O(n) local factors. A local factor commutes with the logical algebra on the enlarged good-syndrome projector; its contribution to a logical expectation is at most twice the square root of its bad-projector prob

import json
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
N=7
D=1<<N
rows=[0b0001111,0b0110011,0b1010101]
C=[0]
for r in rows:
    C += [v^r for v in C.copy()]
z0=np.zeros(D,complex); z0[C]=1/np.sqrt(len(C))
z1=z0[np.arange(D)^127]
# state indices: source A low seven, target B next seven, reference high bit
base=np.zeros(1<<15,complex)
for r,za in enumerate([z0,z1]):
    for a in np.nonzero(za)[0]:
        for b in C:
            base[int(a)+(b<<7)+(r<<14)]=za[a]*z0[b]/np.sqrt(2)
idx=np.arange(base.size)
cnot_idx=idx^((idx&127)<<7)
def pauli_state(v,x,z,n):
    ids=np.arange(v.size)
    signs=np.array([(-1)**((int(j)&z).bit_count()) for j in ids])
    ans=np.empty_like(v); ans[ids^x]=signs*v
    return ans

def h(v,k):
    w=v.reshape((-1,1<<(k+1))).copy(); lo=w[:,:1<<k].copy(); hi=w[:,1<<k:].copy()
    w[:,:1<<k]=(lo+hi)/np.sqrt(2);w[:,1<<k:]=(lo-hi)/np.sqrt(2)
    return w.reshape(-1)
ideal=np.concatenate([z0,z1])/np.sqrt(2)
rng=np.random.default_rng(20261102)
patterns=[(0,0),(127,0),(0,127),(127,127)]+[(int(rng.integers(D)),int(rng.integers(D))) for _ in range(28)]
minimum=1.; branches=0; norm_error=0.
for x,z in patterns:
    state=pauli_state(base,x<<7,z<<7,15)
    out=np.empty_like(state);out[cnot_idx]=state
    for j in range(7):out=h(out,j)
    target=pauli_state(ideal,x,z,8)
    total=0
    for m in range(128):
        branch=out[m::128].copy();p=float(np.vdot(branch,branch).real);total+=p
        if p<1e-14:continue
        # source target-Z propagation shifts the logical X-measurement parity
        if ((m^z).bit_count()%2):branch=pauli_state(branch,0,127,8)
        fidelity=float(abs(np.vdot(target,branch/np.sqrt(p)))**2)
        minimum=min(minimum,fidelity);branches+=1
    norm_error=max(norm_error,abs(total-1))
result={"code":"Steane [[7,1,3]]", "reference":"one external Bell reference", "signed_target_Paulis":len(patterns),"nonzero_measurement_branches":branches,"minimum_reference_safe_branch_fidelity":minimum,"maximum_total_probability_error":norm_error,"scope":"Exact ideal signed-syndrome one-bit teleportation identity only; not circuit-level fault threshold or native thermal basin."}
assert minimum>1-1e-12 and norm_error<1e-12
Path(__file__).with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))

statement: Interleave identical macroscopic CSS blocks at constant 3D density, apply transversal CNOT A to B, measure A in X and decode/track Z^m. A known nonzero target-syndrome frame shifts the X measurements; subtract that shift before decoding logical m. Ideal reference-safe handover uses O(n) registers instead of n growing inner blocks. Reported Steane tests of 32 frames and 512 branches verify algebra only. The input must arrive encoded in the same code or pay conversion; active protection runs throughout preparation, classical delay and waiting. Noisy repeated-check preparation and a circuit threshold do not follow from the syndrome-decoder theorem. An actual frame-covariant unconditional fault contract yields the sampled-syndrome/local-stochastic residual Pauli class up to 2 delta_act, with static decoded error poly(n) exp[-c n^eta]; success conditioning cannot invent independence. Clock reset, dressing and switching outputs are not declared to be the joint Gibbs state. At V=0, exact native logical symmetry protects any gauge state. Generic V needs a nonstationary basin for the actual extensive noisy output. The old filtered-parent preparation does not automatically apply to strong native clocks, and bare-check measurements can destroy actual Gibbs coherences. The equal-resource active-FT comparator receives all controls, resets and cooling with transport, idles and recursive decoding charged. Lifetime alone proves no space or energy advantage.
